scenarios.title: Fictional: Unwanted comments during a journey
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor describes unwanted sexual comments while waiting near a pedestrian route. They changed their plan and want a reviewed account without personal details.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional contributor described unwanted sexual comments near a broad pedestrian area. Publication review does not confirm an event.
scenarios.correctionSummary: This fictional summary was corrected: its original time window was inaccurate. It must not be treated as a current warning.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Private account requesting control
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: an adult contributor reports experiencing sexual violence and wants their account kept private. They do not consent to a public summary or sharing.
scenarios.approvedSummary: No public summary is authorised for this fictional account.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional contributor withdrew this private account.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Raised voices and a confrontation
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor heard raised voices and saw a brief physical confrontation from a distance. They cannot establish the cause or identify anyone involved.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional witness described a confrontation from a distance. Details and cause remain uncertain.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional witness corrected the account. The original description overstated what they could observe.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Hateful remarks near a crossing
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor heard hateful remarks near a pedestrian crossing. No slurs, descriptions of people, or inferred personal attributes are recorded.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional account describes hateful remarks in an approximate public area. No identity or group affiliation is established.
scenarios.correctionSummary: This fictional summary was retracted after its contributor asked to remove the account.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Dim pedestrian sign
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor found a pedestrian sign difficult to read in low light. They used a different crossing and requested a review of wayfinding conditions.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional observation describes a difficult-to-read pedestrian sign. A current maintenance fault has not been confirmed.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional contributor clarified that the issue concerned the sign, not the whole street lighting system.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Unwanted attention while waiting
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor describes unwanted sexual comments while waiting in a public area. They moved toward a staffed venue and want control over any summary.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional contributor described unwanted attention while waiting. This reviewed account is not confirmation of a live incident.
scenarios.correctionSummary: This fictional account was corrected to remove an unsupported claim about repeated behavior.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Private disclosure after an outing
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: an adult contributor describes sexual violence after an outing. They choose private review only and do not want a public map point, quotation, or share.
scenarios.approvedSummary: No public summary is authorised for this fictional account.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional contributor withdrew this private account.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Unclear confrontation at a gathering
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor noticed pushing at a public gathering. Their view was limited, and they cannot tell how it started or whether anyone was hurt.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional observer described pushing with limited visibility. The account does not establish cause or injury.
scenarios.correctionSummary: This fictional account was corrected after the observer clarified the limits of their view.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Hostile remarks affecting a journey
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor describes hateful verbal remarks in a public space and chose to leave. The account includes no slurs, names, or personal characteristics.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional contributor described hostile remarks affecting their journey. This is a reviewed account, not a verified finding.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional contributor requested withdrawal of this summary. It must not remain in current shared views.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Obstructed walking space
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor found temporary objects narrowing a walking route. They could not determine who placed them and chose another entrance.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional observation describes a narrowed pedestrian route. Its current condition and responsible operator are unconfirmed.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional contributor updated the account: the temporary obstruction was no longer present in the exercise.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Unwanted comments near a waiting area
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor reports unwanted sexual comments near a waiting area. They ended their wait and want a brief reviewed summary with no identifiable details.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional contributor described unwanted comments near an approximate waiting area. No current threat is established.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional summary was corrected because the contributor could not support the original timing.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Private disclosure with no publication
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: an adult contributor reports sexual violence and asks for control over retention. They decline publication, map display, and sharing of their account.
scenarios.approvedSummary: No public summary is authorised for this fictional account.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional contributor withdrew this private account.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Witness account with limited detail
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor observed a brief physical struggle from across a public space. They did not approach and cannot identify the participants or explain the event.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional witness described a struggle from a distance. The limited account does not establish who was involved or why.
scenarios.correctionSummary: This fictional account was corrected to remove a conclusion the witness could not support.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Hateful language during a wait
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor describes hearing hateful language while waiting. They left the area. The account does not quote the language or identify anyone.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional account describes hateful language in an approximate waiting area. Review does not establish an offence or identity.
scenarios.correctionSummary: This fictional summary was withdrawn at the contributor request and is no longer available for sharing.

scenarios.title: Fictional: Confusing access sign
scenarios.description: Fictional scenario: a contributor could not understand a temporary access sign and took a longer route. They request clearer information rather than an assessment of personal danger.
scenarios.approvedSummary: A fictional observation describes unclear access information. Current transport operations must be checked with the operator.
scenarios.correctionSummary: The fictional contributor clarified which sign was unclear. This is not evidence that the interchange is closed.
